methodologyNotes: Dataset covers 13 inversion tables actively sold in the US market as of 2026-08-01, spanning premium FDA-registered clinical-style tables (Teeter FitSpine X3/LX9, EP-560) through mid-tier heat/massage models (Innova ITM4800, Health Gear ITM5500, Merax Vibration Massage) to budget imports (Innova ITX9600/ITX9800, Yoleo Gravity, Body Vision IT9825, Body Champ IT8070, Exerpeutic 975SL, Ironman Gravity 4000). Teeter and Innova specs were verified directly against official manufacturer pages (teeter.com, innovaproductsinc.com). Health Gear (made by Extreme Products Group), Ironman Fitness, Body Champ, Exerpeutic, Yoleo, Merax, and Body Vision do not publish independent spec-sheet pages for these models, so their specs were cross-referenced against the specialist retailer InversionZone.com, owner's manuals (ManualsLib), and multiple general retailers (Walmart, Best Buy, Lowe's, Academy Sports, eBay, Mozeve, CreedZone, Sunburst Fitness, Amazon/Amazon.ca) plus independent review sites (TreadmillReviewGuru, FitnessMachineReviews, HealthFitnessPlanets). Pricing for the budget-import brands fluctuates significantly across sellers and none of these brands publish a fixed manufacturer MSRP; priceUsd reflects the clearest single-retailer price found at a directly-accessed source (or the retailer's own 'list'/'was' price where a sale price was also shown), with the observed cross-retailer spread documented in priceNote rather than averaged or estimated. 'Sky Fitness Deluxe' from the initial seed list could not be matched to any real, currently-sold product under that name across manufacturer sites, major retailers, or review aggregators despite multiple targeted searches, so it was dropped and replaced with three additional well-documented models (Innova ITM4800, Merax Vibration Massage Inversion Table, Body Vision IT9825) to keep the dataset at 13 independently verifiable entries. heat_massage is recorded as 'None' for the Teeter FitSpine X3/LX9 because their only comfort add-on is a passive, non-electric acupressure-node insert with no heating element — distinct from true powered heat+vibration pad systems (Innova ITM4800, Health Gear ITM5500, Merax). Several budget models could not be confirmed for assembled_weight_lb, an exact degree-by-degree inversion_angle_range, ankle_lock_type detail, or foldability (chiefly Innova ITX9800, Merax, and parts of Body Vision IT9825 and Yoleo Gravity) because no manufacturer spec sheet publishes them and the largest retailers (Amazon, Walmart, Lowe's, Academy Sports, Dick's Sporting Goods, Best Buy) blocked automated access with CAPTCHA/anti-bot walls during verification on 2026-08-01 — these fields are left null rather than estimated, per the no-guessing rule. All sources accessed 2026-08-01 unless a specific page displayed an explicit earlier data timestamp, which is called out in that product's priceNote.
